findings.where: Second appended page of all 12 decks (table row 5, column 3); source: build.mjs rows[5]
findings.summary: The slide says the remaining real acceptance is 'AT-26〜30は継続', which removes AT-24 and AT-25 from the remaining list. The canonical r19 registry still lists them as remaining and HOLD/BLOCKED.
findings.evidence: Slide text: '顧客確認6件・残る実受入 | 引き続き確認 | 顧客0/6。AT-26〜30は継続'. docs/traceability/registry.json facts.remainingRealAcceptance = [AT-24, AT-25, AT-26, AT-27, AT-28, AT-29, AT-30]; REQ-24 and REQ-25 are HOLD/BLOCKED; docs/acceptance/08_ACCEPTANCE_RESULTS.md headings read 'AT-24 ...: BLOCKED' and 'AT-25 ...: BLOCKED'; the deck's own notes say '状態欄は変更していない' and the evening record EVE-07 says the remaining real-acceptance list was not updated. The same slide does say '受入の合格ではありません', so the page contradicts itself rather than claiming a pass outright, but a reader of the table would conclude AT-24/25 are no longer outstanding. This is the overstatement the review was asked to look for, on the slide face of every deck.
findings.suggestedFix: Change the cell to '顧客0/6。AT-24〜30は継続' (or '顧客0/6。AT-24・25を含む実受入7件は継続'), rebuild the 12 decks, rerun review_and_propose.py and have the new proposal reviewed. Consider adding an assertion in build.mjs that the slide's remaining list equals reg.facts.remainingRealAcceptance.
